evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into "This is the move starting 7150 Craig ranch parkway, right?" with no time-boxing, promise framing, or wait for agreement.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep goes straight into logistics probing ("Do you have anything kind of like oversized or heavy...") without asking about concerns or goals.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised by customer.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives range ("$2,040 to $28,560" with 5–7 hours, 4 guys, 2 trucks, $102/hour per mover, $408/hour for crew, 2.5-hour minimum) but does not personalize it to the customer's stated situation, prep level, or concerns.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses the hourly rate ($102/person, $408 crew, 2.5-hour minimum) but does not frame the "not a guess" commitment or mention trip/overnight fees upfront.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Customer volunteers comparison shopping and price sensitivity; rep does not ask "Does that feel fair?" or hold silence for response.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks "Would you like our help with your move?" Instead, customer ends the call saying "I'll get back to you in a couple of days via email" and rep says "My pleasure" — no ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking details confirmed. Customer says "week of the ninth" vaguely; rep confirms "Monday to Thursday is cheapest" but does not lock in a date, time window, crew size, addresses, or notes for the crew. Call ends with customer saying she will email back.

top_strength: Jules gathered extensive logistics detail and itemization from the customer (furniture dimensions, special pieces, assembly needs, storage unit specifics, placement floors) with patience and acknowledgment, building a clear picture of the move.
coaching_note: Section 1 is missing the quid pro quo framing entirely — jump straight into probing with no time-box or promise of a dependable quote; Section 2 skips their agenda completely; Section 7 never asks for the business, leaving the customer to volunteer a callback instead of a confirmed booking.
